# SHOWstudio

> > SHOWstudio is a pioneering fashion film and digital content platform showcasing haute couture, ready-to-wear collections, and innovative digital fashion experiences.

Founded as an experimental fashion platform, SHOWstudio documents runway shows from Paris and beyond, featuring designers like Viktor&Rolf, Valentino, Chanel, and Jean Paul Gaultier. The platform bridges traditional haute couture with emerging digital fashion, including metaverse fashion weeks and virtual runway experiences.

## Key Topics

- Haute Couture
- Paris Fashion Week
- Viktor&Rolf (Viktor Horsting & Rolf Snoeren)
- Valentino (Pierpaolo Piccioli)
- Chanel
- Jean Paul Gaultier
- Glenn Martens
- Giambattista Valli
- Metaverse Fashion Week
- Digital Fashion & Web3
- Runway Coverage
- Designer Collections
- Fashion Film
- Decentraland Virtual Fashion
